rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the afternoon of 8 June 2010, in which 仙谷由人 introduced himself as the incoming Chief Cabinet Secretary and announced the list of ministers of the 菅直人内閣, says the Prime Minister's press conference was scheduled for 17:00, the Imperial appointment ceremony and attestation (親任式及び認証式) for 18:15 and the first cabinet meeting for 21:30.
